note: Every related repository at the commit this repository read it. Sessions read others only at these pins (RULES 7). Update a pin in its own PR, saying why.

angband.role: The game and the original C Borg (src/borg/). The engine every Borg in the family plays; the original C Borg is baseline 4.2.6 in borg-zoo.

borg-rs.role: Template for structure, tooling and external behaviour; source of the angband/ tree with the borgh harness (T1.1), the harness scripts (T1.2), engine.rs (T1.3) and the launchers (T1.4); perception oracle (T2.5).

better-borg-c.role: C Borg with verified fixes (baseline 4.2.6-bbc-m7), native measurement runner, death dossiers (copied in reference/deaths/better-borg-c/).

neo-angband-tracker.role: The C Borg specification and the Tunable Borg Plan (copied in reference/c-borg/); the issue board for C Borg defects.

borg-zoo.role: The yardstick: suites, specimens, outcome vocabulary, the borg-rs adapter (zoo/borgrs.py) the reborn Borg must satisfy (T1.5). Design and catalogue copied in reference/zoo/.

borg-agent.role: Language-model player producing claims with evidence; its reviewed claims are inputs to strategy design (GOALS D11). Workflow template (milestones, reviewed branch).
